Privacy Policy

EZ Duas is designed to be useful without collecting personal information.

Information collection

EZ Duas does not require an account and does not collect, transmit, sell, or share personal information. The app does not use advertising or cross-app tracking.

Information stored on your device

Preferences, favorites, and personal collections are stored locally on your device so the app can remember your choices. This information is not transmitted to us.

Third-party services

EZ Duas does not include third-party analytics, advertising SDKs, or social-network tracking. Content can be shared only when you choose to use Apple’s system sharing tools.

Children’s privacy

Because EZ Duas does not collect personal information, it does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes to this policy

If the app’s privacy practices change, this policy will be updated before those changes take effect.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent to contact@issacodeworks.com.
